ui.about_lead: Yi-athlasi yemozulu esebenza nangaphandle kolayini efumana umbane ophilayo xa uceliwe. Yonke imigangatho yemozulu yehlabathi ibhakiwe kwaye ifundeka ungaxhunywanga; iimeko zangoku, iziqikelelo, izilumkiso namanqanaba e-raster ziyalandwa kuphela xa uzicela.

ui.about_privacy: Iimpawu zakho zekhaya nekhonkco lakho le-OpenWeatherMap zihlala kule browser kuphela kwaye azisoze zithunyelwe ndawo. Le app iqala ingenanxibelelwano lwe-network konke konke; ifikelela kuphela kwidatha ephilayo oyiceleyo, ithumela kuphela iikhoodinethi ezifunekayo.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — yasimahla kwaye iqala ingaxhunywanga. Ufundo ngalunye lubonisa ixesha lalo; xa ungaxhunywanga, imigangatho ebhakiweyo iyaqhubeka.

ui.disc_body:
I-Weatherglass sisixhobo solwazi, ingesosixhobo sokhuseleko. Idatha yemozulu, iziqikelelo, uthotho lwembali kunye nezilumkiso ezisemthethweni zilandwa kwimithombo yesithathu (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, i-US National Weather Service, amaziko emozulu esizwe, GDACS, ne-OpenWeatherMap xa ufaka iqhosha lakho). Zinokulibaziseka, zingapheleli, zibe yimpazamo, okanye zingafumaneki, kwaye i-Weatherglass isenokungazifundi ngokuchanekileyo okanye isilele ukuzibonisa.

Musa ukusebenzisa le app ukwenza izigqibo apho ubomi, impilo, impahla okanye ukhuseleko lohambo lusengozini — kubandakanya izaqhwithi, izikhukula, iinqwelomoya, ukuhamba ngenqanawa, ukukhwela iintaba okanye umsebenzi wangaphandle. Ngamaxesha onke landela igunya lakho lasekhaya lezemozulu kunye nemiyalelo yokhuseleko loluntu; izilumkiso zabo zithatha indawo yokuqala kunayo nantoni na eboniswa apha.

I-athlasi yemozulu engaxhunyiwe ibonisa imiyinge yexesha elide (1991–2020) kunye neerekhodi zembali. Ichaza iimeko eziqhelekileyo, ingesosiya kuba yimozulu kanye ngosuku oluthile.

Indawo isetyenziswa kuphela xa ucofa ukuyisebenzisa, kuphela ukulanda imozulu yaloo ndawo, kwaye ayisoze igcinwe nguthi. Iimpawu zakho zekhaya nezicwangciso zihlala kule divayisi.

I-Weatherglass inikezelwa mahala, “njengoko injalo”, ngaphandle kwesiqinisekiso saluphi na uhlobo. Ngokupheleleyo okuvunyelweyo ngumthetho, umbhali wayo akemi tyala nakuphi na ukulahlekelwa okanye umonakalo ovela ekuyisebenziseni okanye ekuxhomekekeni kumxholo wayo.

Ngokucofa Ndiyaqonda kwaye ndiyavuma uqinisekisa ukuba ulifundile esi saziso. Sibonakaliswa kwakhona emva kohlaziyo ngalunye.
